title: Chantilly
description: What if we gave more flavor and features to vanilla? Let's add some Chantilly on top!
body:
# **Welcome to Chantilly!**




  This is my personal modpack, it's meant to gather lot's of differents _mods_ and _ressource pack_; some are for experienced vanilla player who likes **QoL** (things like litematica or tweakeroo), some are **tools for content creators** (replay mod, mocap...), other for **performance** (sodium, lithium...), and other for **immersion improvements** (iris, betterclouds...)

**This modpack is still in alpha version, futur version will see improvements and fixes**

Lastest version available: Alpha2.1


##  Enjoy the taste of Chantilly !
